metadata.title: AI Semantic Data Loss Prevention

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for preventing semantic, inferential, and generative leakage of sensitive information by AI systems.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: AI privacy-enhancing technologies, semantic analysis tools, and generative output controls.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining how AI outputs are analyzed and constrained to prevent indirect or semantic leakage of sensitive information.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-specific threat context for privacy inference, membership inference, and sensitive information leakage through generation.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where AI systems reveal sensitive information through paraphrase, inference, or aggregation rather than direct copying.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where AI outputs enable identification of individuals or sensitive attributes without explicit disclosure.

metadata.remarks: AI Semantic Data Loss Prevention defines how AI systems are prevented from leaking sensitive information through inference, paraphrase, summarization, or probabilistic generation. This pattern extends traditional DLP concepts to address AI-native privacy and confidentiality risks.

components.title: Sensitive Concept Detection
components.description: Detection of sensitive concepts, entities, or attributes in AI-generated outputs regardless of literal wording.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI outputs are analyzed for semantically sensitive content even when exact sensitive strings are not present.

components.title: Inferential Risk Analysis
components.description: Assessment of whether AI outputs could enable inference of protected or regulated information.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI outputs are evaluated for the potential to enable re-identification or sensitive attribute inference.

components.title: Output Reuse Controls
components.description: Governance over how AI-generated outputs may be stored, reused, shared, or published.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies restrict reuse or dissemination of AI outputs that may contain sensitive or inferentially revealing information.
